newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - April 23.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- China is ready to further enhance, consolidate and add new content to its relations with every country in Africa, Premier Li Peng tells a delegation from Mauritania in Beijing.
- Premier Li Peng tells visiting World Trade Organisation chief Renato Ruggiero that China's entry to the trade body should not be politicised.
- The China International Trust and Investment Corp (CITIC) mulls the launch of up to $250 million in floating rate notes.
- Pre-tax profits of the Yanshan Petrochemical Co hit 1.95 billion yuan in 1996 on sales of 16.2 billion yuan.
- The central bank orders commercial banks to focus on sales of 40 billion yuan in treasury bonds to be issued from May 1-31.
- China has planted an estimated 31.88 million hectares of summer grain this year, an increase of 333,500 hectares compared with 1996.

- President Jiang Zemin, on an official trip to Russia, said a new relationship between China and Russia will serve the fundamental interests of both nations and is conducive to peace, stability and development in the Asia-Pacific region and the world.
